notes.title: update V1.1.2: New input options / bug fixes and quality of life.
notes.notes:
This is the V1.1.2 update:

Due to feedback I have added a New input options.
-You can now use right trigger to use the dash as an alternative button.
-You can now use left trigger to use the hover move as an alternative button.

Bug fixes and quality of life.
-Black bars no longer obscure view when playing on unintended aspect ratios.
-UI no longer shows red coins on secret levels.
-A new sound will play when you try to use water but have no water to use.

notes.title: update V1.1.0: Improved wall jump and final boss/ ending changes
notes.notes:
this is the V1.1.0 update:

Due to feedback I have improved the wall jump to convey more information to the player.
-Super jump star effect stops when wall jump initiated.
-Dust effect when sliding off of wall.
-Wall grab animation is more snappy.
-sound design for both grabbing onto the wall and sliding off of it.

Other changes.
-Other player animations have been slightly tweaked to feel better.
-In the final boss area more water has been added to the start of the area.
-Pillars have been added to the middle of the final boss arena to stand on.
-small changes of the ending.
